title: rip shakespeare you would have loved sam gold’s romeo & juliet. 🧸 #ra...
transcript: Did you know that Romeo and Juliet is a comedy? Okay, yes, ultimately, it is a tragedy, but I went to the first preview of Sam Gold's Romeo and Juliet at the circle in the Square Theater, and I was shocked by how much I laughed. The entire first act is the Montagues and the Capulets goofing off and being teens mixed with these incredibly violent confrontations. And that juxtaposition is why this play still hits so hard, because the true tragedy of Romeo and Juliet is their youth. It is the perfect show and perfect roles for the highly anticipated Broadway debuts of Rachel Zegler and Kit Connor, because you can feel their youthful passion in every line and every soliloquy. They are deeply in love and also deeply dramatic, and everything feels so intense in the way that young love often does. And because of their focus on the youth, this production embraces Gen Z aesthetic. Capulet carries a Borge, Paris vapes, Juliet's wearing barrel jeans. Things are neon and ironic, like, and I just loved every second of it. If you, like me, love Shakespeare, then this is an adaptation I think that you will really get into because it feels fresh and relevant and exciting. But I also think this is one of the most approachable Shakespeare adaptations I've ever seen. So if you're someone that gets a little nervous around Shakespeare, I think this is one that you will really enjoy. What an incredibly special First preview welcome to Broadway.
reasoning: Creator attended first preview and gives an enthusiastic, unqualified recommendation, praising the leads, direction, and accessibility.
keyQuote: I just loved every second of it.
